description: Source code for a Lauterbach T32 debugger terminal driver, including functions for initializing, reading, writing, and opening the serial interface, as well as device configuration.

methods.name: t32_writebyte
methods.description: Sends a byte to the T32 port, waiting until the port is free.

methods.name: T32_Init
methods.description: Initializes the T32 interface; currently does nothing.

methods.name: t32_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the T32 terminal, converting newlines to carriage return + newline.

methods.name: t32_Read
methods.description: Reads data from the T32 terminal, waiting for input.

methods.name: t32_Open
methods.description: Opens the T32 device; currently a stub returning 0.
